operator-walkthrough.ref: Q-23 phase 2 (2026-09-30, branch nickstire/q23-phase2-unmeasured-revenue). What the operator sees on Admin > Intelligence HQ, 'Today, for real' card: only when the invoice mirror has never synced an invoice (todayPulse throughDate is null) does anything change. The revenue tag then reads UNMEASURED instead of ESTIMATE, and the amber banner reads 'No invoices have synced yet, so revenue above is not measured.' instead of 'Invoice sync is no invoices synced - revenue above is understated'. With any synced invoice the card renders exactly as before (production held 2,838 invoices when todayPulse was built on 2026-07-20; not re-read now). The second change is invisible: a tile naming a metric the contract lacks now falls back to ESTIMATE in a production bundle instead of throwing during render; dev and test still throw. Proof is a jsdom render, not a live admin session: client/src/__tests__/todays-real-numbers-unmeasured.test.tsx (never-synced revenue: 3 render tests + 3 pure; red on main for the UNMEASURED tag and the banner wording, the stale-mirror case is its positive control) and client/src/__tests__/todays-real-numbers-unknown-metric.test.tsx (contract lookup mocked to drop 'Tool engagements': 2 of 3 red on main because the card threw; the dev/test-still-throws case is the control). Not yet seen by the operator on the installed PWA.
